# Greg Nunn Art

> Portfolio and print shop of Australian artist Greg Nunn, featuring contemporary oil paintings of landscapes, seascapes, and portraits.

Greg Nunn is a Brisbane-based artist specializing in museum-quality original paintings and giclee prints. His work captures iconic Australian locations like Moreton Bay and the Twelve Apostles, alongside portrait commissions and figurative pieces.

## Key Topics

- Oil painting
- Australian artist
- Original artwork
- Landscape art
- Portrait painting

## Portfolio & Paintings

- [Portfolio](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio): Gallery showcasing Greg Nunn's paintings across landscapes, seascapes, and portraits
- [Morning Reflections](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio/morning-reflections): Oil painting of pelicans at Moreton Bay, available as museum-quality prints
- [Rise and Shine](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio/rise-and-shine): Oil painting of Moreton Bay and Redcliffe Jetty sunrise scene
- [Coastal Drama](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio/coastal-drama): Oil painting of the Twelve Apostles, Victoria in original artwork
- [A Night Time Story](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio/a-night-time-story): Brisbane cityscape oil painting featuring Story Bridge, Lethbridge Award finalist
- [Delicate Balance](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio/delicate-balance): Oil painting with butterfly theme exploring life's delicate balance
- [The Man Behind the Music](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio/the-man-behind-the-music): Portrait painting of Mark Brownlee, Brisbane music industry entrepreneur
- [Eyes to the future](https://gregnunnart.com/portfolio/eyes-to-the-future): Oil on board portrait painting capturing a confident figurative moment
